_doc: CG-001 field-semantics ledger. The anti-invention table that drives every label on dock.html. Machine-readable on purpose: CG-001 writes NO prose .md restating this. Each entry declares what a field MEANS, what EVIDENCE supports that meaning, how far it may be USED (usableAs), whether its semantics are documented, and the EXACT label the page prints. A field with usableAs 'none' may be printed and nothing else.
_doc_usableAs: price | trend | count | reference | none. NOTHING in CG-001 is usableAs 'price' — the feed exposes no order book and no verified price.
_doc_semantics: DOCUMENTED (the source documents it) | UNDOCUMENTED (the value is real but its meaning is not stated) | DREW_SOURCED (Drew's own words, not a feed field) | DERIVED_VIEW_ONLY (CG's arithmetic, for display only) | UNRESOLVED (a guard that could not be settled in CG-001).
_doc_segments: Ruling N's per-segment fields live on items[].segments[] in dock.json. The task package names them parts[].feedAvg etc.; that name is kept here as a declared alias so the spec's mandatory table is satisfied, while segments[] is where the data actually is. Both names refer to the same thing and the page reads segments[].
_doc_count: 24 semantic entries under .fields + 58 structural keys under .structure = 82 declared keys. Every key the page reads is declared in one of those two blocks (oracle P9); .structure carries shape/routing keys that have usableAs 'none' and no label of their own, plus 3 explicit aliases of a .fields entry.
_doc_structure: The page also reads keys that carry no market meaning — ordinals, anchors, join bookkeeping, coverage counters and the display-mode switches. They are declared here so the P9 claim is literally true rather than aspirational. Each has usableAs 'none': it may be printed as an identifier and nothing else, and none may be turned into a price, a trend or a judgement.

custom_avg._doc: The feed's per-item average. Drew's EST values are based on sell listings plus his own volume and market-interaction analysis, which is why this is a FAIR-VALUE REFERENCE and not a circular echo of his estimate.
custom_avg.meaning: Feed-supplied average figure for an item. Its exact construction is not stated by the source.
custom_avg.label: AVG (UNDOC)
custom_avg.note: The source stores it as a STRING (e.g. "6.5"). CG preserves it verbatim; only partsSum does arithmetic on it.

today_vol.meaning: Today's trade volume count for an item.
today_vol.label: VOL TODAY
today_vol.note: Trend only. Never a price, never a demand score.

yesterday_vol.meaning: Yesterday's trade volume count for an item.
yesterday_vol.label: VOL YEST

estValueRaw._doc: Drew's own Est Value cell, carried as his exact string. NEVER a number.
estValueRaw.meaning: Drew's stated estimate for the set. Three shapes all occur: a range like '74-80p', a single like '25p', or a sentinel (LOCKED / TRAP / HOLD).
estValueRaw.label: YOUR EST
estValueRaw.note: Parsing the range or single shape is a VIEW-TIME concern only; dock.json holds strings. The sentinels are his words and must never be parsed into a number.

liveActionPlan._doc: Drew's words in the Live Action Plan column. ALWAYS rendered, verbatim, first and largest. Never edited, never summarised, never truncated in GLANCE.
liveActionPlan.meaning: Drew's stated action for this item.

evidence.source: Drew's xlsx, TradeDock column 'Live Action Plan'

liveActionPlan.label: YOUR PLAN
liveActionPlan.note: No number is EVER harvested from this prose. drewValue stays null until Drew states a value in chat.

marketRead._doc: Drew's free-text market read (ruling L). Printed verbatim, never interpreted, never scored, never matched on.
marketRead.meaning: Drew's own prose about how an item trades — his behavioural half of his method.
marketRead.label: YOUR MARKET READ
marketRead.note: null on 34 of 35 items. Only Scattered Justice is seeded. No behavioural taxonomy was invented (no demandQuality / exitLiquidity / noobDemand).

estDelta._doc: Display-only arithmetic comparing Drew's Est Value against the feed average. Weaker than either input.
estDelta.meaning: Signed comparison of Drew's estimate against custom_avg, rendered for his eye.

evidence.fieldPath: (view only, never persisted as a lane)

estDelta.label: EST vs AVG
estDelta.note: Never coloured good/bad, never sorted on, never thresholded, never fed to a flag. Range compares against the MIDPOINT and is labelled 'vs mid'. Sentinels (LOCKED / TRAP / HOLD) render NO delta at all.

segments[].feedAvg._doc: Per-segment average (ruling N). The task package names this parts[].feedAvg; both names are declared here and refer to the same field.
segments[].feedAvg.meaning: The feed average for one part slot of one item.
segments[].feedAvg.label: AVG (UNDOC)
segments[].feedAvg.note: NEVER primeSellingPrice. An unhit segment is null and renders [INACCESSIBLE] — never 0.

segments[].feedVolToday.meaning: Today's volume for one part slot.
segments[].feedVolToday.label: VOL TODAY

segments[].feedVolYest.meaning: Yesterday's volume for one part slot.
segments[].feedVolYest.label: VOL YEST

segments[].drewValue._doc: A value Drew states in chat for a specific segment. null on ALL 122 slots in CG-001.
segments[].drewValue.meaning: Drew's own per-segment value, when he has stated one.
segments[].drewValue.label: YOUR VALUE
segments[].drewValue.note: NEVER regex a number out of liveActionPlan. The column renders and is empty everywhere in CG-001.

segments[].have._doc: Drew's own possession bit. HAVE or MISSING — never NEED (ruling M).
segments[].have.meaning: Whether Drew's sheet says he owns this piece. 1.0 means HAVE; 0.0 is the only MISSING value. Scattered Justice carries 2.0 (a mod quantity), which is also a HAVE.
segments[].have.label: HAVE
segments[].have.note: missing[] is arithmetic on Drew's own stated possession. A missing list is headed 'YOUR BITS SHOW MISSING'.

partsSum._doc: Derived sum of a row's segment averages. The denominator is ALWAYS carried so a partial sum can never present as a total.
partsSum.meaning: Sum of the priced segments of one item, with its coverage stated.
partsSum.label: PARTS SUM · n of m SEGMENTS
partsSum.note: A partial sum (a value with pricedSegments < totalSegments) renders greyed + struck + INCOMPLETE. When NOTHING is priced the value is null and the line renders [INACCESSIBLE] — it is not a sum at all, so it is not struck. NEVER a bare number. Never a default sort key.

ducats.meaning: In-game platinum value of a part per the catalog.
ducats.label: DUCATS

primeSellingPrice._doc: GUARD. The task package measured this field as equal to the same part's ducats in every row checked, and instructed that a failure to hold universally be recorded as UNRESOLVED.
primeSellingPrice.meaning: Unknown in CG-001: the field does not appear in either CG-000 snapshot.
primeSellingPrice.label: PRIME SELLING REF
primeSellingPrice.note: FINDING (CG-001): zero occurrences across market__wfinfo-prices.json and market__wfinfo-filtered_items.json. The task package's quoted N/N pairs (Sybaris Barrel 100/100, Blueprint 15/15, Receiver 45/45, Stock 15/15, Ivara Prime Blueprint 45/45) match the catalog's ducats values EXACTLY, which supports the guard's conclusion that it is not a platinum price — but the field itself could not be verified against these inputs. CG-001 never reads it, and oracle P24 enforces that statically.

evidence.source: not present in the CG-000 price rows

uniqueName.label: ID
uniqueName.note: CG-001 keys on the plain feed name; no uniqueName is read or printed.

timestamp._doc: The snapshot's own fetchedAt. NOT streamDate — streamDate is absent.
timestamp.meaning: When the CG-000 snapshot was taken.
timestamp.label: SNAPSHOT
timestamp.note: Every price shows its snapshot age. There is NO live reader in CG-001; CG must never imply one.

priceability.meaning: Whether a dock target has a public Set row in the snapshot.

evidence.source: CG derivation from the price snapshot

priceability.label: PRICEABLE
priceability.note: 32 of 35. NO_PUBLIC_PRICE is NOT 'no value' — any such row must also render marketRead when present.

syndicateMissions._doc: TRAP FIELD. Easy to misread as the player's standing with a faction.
syndicateMissions.meaning: Faction mission rotation data. It says nothing about the player's standing.
syndicateMissions.label: ⚠ TRAP: faction rotation, NOT player standing
syndicateMissions.note: Listed so it can never be mistaken for a player-scoped field.

playerScopedFields._doc: Every player-scoped field (inventory, standing, mastery, progress, owned items) is unreachable from every automated source (CG-000 §6).
playerScopedFields.meaning: Data about Drew's account or possessions specifically.
playerScopedFields.label: [INACCESSIBLE]
playerScopedFields.note: Renders as [INACCESSIBLE] with a reason. Never 0, never an em-dash.

missing[].meaning: The slots Drew's own qty bits mark 0.0 — arithmetic on stated possession, not invention.
missing[].label: YOUR BITS SHOW MISSING
missing[].note: For a mod whose parts are all N/A the list is [] and NEVER ['N/A']. An empty list is a statement about the SHEET, not about the foundry — see the WISP-ASSEMBLY conflict.

lastSync._doc: When Drew last personally scrubbed his bag + market values. Global bag date + per-item dates. DREW_SOURCED — seeded only from Drew's word (CG-003). null everywhere until he says a date. Never derived, never guessed, never inferred from other fields.
lastSync.meaning: Top-level block recording Drew's own sync timestamps for bag and per-item market reads.
lastSync.label: LAST SYNC
lastSync.note: Never derived, never guessed; null until Drew says a date.

bagScrub.meaning: Date Drew last personally scrubbed his bag.
bagScrub.label: BAG SCRUB
bagScrub.note: Never derived, never guessed; null until Drew says a date.

skipCostPlat.meaning: Plat cost to skip a timer, when set.
skipCostPlat.label: SKIP COST

endsAt.meaning: Timer end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm format.
endsAt.label: ENDS AT

structure._doc: Shape, identity, join bookkeeping, coverage counters and display switches. usableAs is 'none' for every one of them: each may be printed as an identifier and nothing else. Declared so oracle P9 ('every key the page reads is declared') is literally true rather than aspirational.
structure._doc_note: bpMainQty, vaulted, jujuRsv and wantedBy are Drew's own sheet state, not feed data: they are identity/possession routing only and may never be read as value, demand or permission.

xlsxRow.meaning: Source row 2-36 in the xlsx, kept as an anchor back to Drew's sheet.

item.meaning: Drew's item name verbatim. The join key, never a market claim.

velocityTier.meaning: One of the 7 tier words observed in the sheet. A label, never a number.

bpMainQty.meaning: Drew's quantity bit for BP/Main. 1.0 HAVE, 0.0 MISSING, never NEED.

wantedBy.meaning: Drew's wanted-by note. Never read as demand or liquidity.

parts.meaning: Ruling N's shape name for the segment list; segments[] is where the data lives.

segments.meaning: The per-segment rows rendered in GLANCE and DEEP. Per-segment FIELD semantics are declared under .fields.

slot.meaning: Segment slot name as written by Drew, e.g. Blade, BP, Main.

qty.meaning: Drew's possession bit for that slot. The literal string N/A is preserved.

have.meaning: Ruling M's rendering of qty: HAVE, MISSING, or the N/A sentinel.

flags.meaning: The closed set of 13 flag words actually present in this snapshot. No flag outside the closed fourteen may be added.

missing.meaning: Array form of the 0.0 bits. Semantics and label are declared under .fields as missing[].

setPrice.meaning: A whole-set price row when the feed has one. It is a reference like any other and NEVER the segment value.

partsSum.meaning: Derived sum container. Its own fields are declared below.

value.meaning: partsSum arithmetic average of the priced segments, or null when none are priced. The denominator always travels with it.

pricedSegments.meaning: Count of segments that carry a feed average.

totalSegments.meaning: Count of segments Drew's sheet lists for that row.

complete.meaning: true only when pricedSegments === totalSegments. Drives the struck + INCOMPLETE treatment; it is never a completion claim about the item.

matchShape.meaning: How the segment matched the catalog: 'SEGMENT', 'PRIME_SET' or 'MAIN_BLUEPRINT'.

matchedName.meaning: The catalog name the join landed on, kept for audit.

drewValue.meaning: A value Drew states per segment. null on all 122 slots in CG-001.

estValueBasis.meaning: Which input a view-time delta was computed against.

authority.meaning: Provenance stamp: who produced the master and from which immutable inputs.

provenance.meaning: Input file paths, sizes and mtimes. Audit only.

source.meaning: Snapshot timestamps for the xlsx and each feed. Drives the SNAPSHOT age label.

catalogMiss.meaning: Rows absent from the equipment catalog, listed for audit.

conflicts.meaning: The 4 OPEN — AWAITING DREW discrepancies. Rendered verbatim; never auto-resolved.

externalStores.meaning: Declares that the page reads no external store. Offline by construction.

feedErrors.meaning: Count and wording of the 11 snapshot warnings surfaced in the relic panel.

inventory.meaning: Declared empty — no player inventory is available. Must never be filled in.

joinAliases.meaning: Approved join aliases. EMPTY in CG-001 — no alias was approved, so Daikyu Upper/Lower stay inaccessible.

joinCoverage.meaning: Feed-row join counters: joined, priceRows, unjoinedCount and the classification of every unjoined row.

priceability.meaning: How many rows carry a set price and which are inaccessible. Display-only.

scratchpad.meaning: Drew's 2 spare scratch rows. Never rendered, never merged into items.

velocityTiers.meaning: The observed tier vocabulary. A closed list, never extended.

name.meaning: Legacy per-segment name alias retained from ruling N.

feedAvg.meaning: Bare alias of fields['segments[].feedAvg']. The page reads the bare key on items[].segments[]; the spec names the field with the segments[] prefix. Both refer to the same value.
feedAvg.label: AVG (UNDOC)

feedVolToday.meaning: Bare alias of fields['segments[].feedVolToday']. The page reads the bare key on items[].segments[]; the spec names the field with the segments[] prefix. Both refer to the same value.
feedVolToday.label: VOL TODAY

feedVolYest.meaning: Bare alias of fields['segments[].feedVolYest']. The page reads the bare key on items[].segments[]; the spec names the field with the segments[] prefix. Both refer to the same value.
feedVolYest.label: VOL YEST

id.meaning: Identifier of a conflict entry or timer id.

snapshot.meaning: The snapshot block build-dock.js adds to the bundle: fetchedAt stamps, the SNAPSHOT age label, and the static-not-live disclosure. CG-001 has NO live reader; this stamp is the page's honesty about the age of every price it prints.

prices.meaning: The 758 snapshot price rows carried whole for audit. The page must NOT join against it at runtime — every join already happened in the importer and is frozen into items[].segments[].

perItem.meaning: Map of item names to last sync dates.
